entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Smt. Shashi Jain Vs. State of M.P. Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Mahesh Goyal, Counsel for applicant.
Ms. Kalpana Parmar, Counsel for State.
This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C has been filed seeking following relief :

"It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow the instant petition and FIR dated 7.10.2019 registered at FIR No.578/2019 for the offence u/s 420, 272, & 273 of IPC and section 51 & 53 Food Safety and Standard Act may be quashed.
And the charge sheet filed by the police may also be quashed and all other subsequent proceedings pursuant to charge sheet may also be quashed."

After arguing the matter at length, Counsel for applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to raise all possible defences which may be available to applicant under the law.
With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G.S. Ahluwalia) Judge Arun* ARUN KUMAR MISHRA 2022.04.29 18:16:38 +05'30'
